visual.general_description: Color diagram of immersive virtual reality inputs, outputs and feedback between participant, virtual environment and therapist.
visual.detailed_description: Colored schematic with a grey pictogram of a person wearing a headset and holding two controllers on the left, a grey pictogram of a person in a white coat at the lower middle, and a first-person virtual-environment screenshot at the upper right with a smaller smartphone screen at the lower right showing the same scene. Labelled boxes and arrows: a magenta arrow headed INPUTS pointing rightward toward the virtual-environment screenshot with a box listing "VRi headset" and "Controllers"; a blue arrow headed OUTPUTS pointing leftward toward the headset pictogram with a box listing "Acoustic stimuli", "Visual stimuli", "Vibrotactile stimuli" and "Changes in VR environment"; a label "Virtual environment" under the screenshot with an orange down arrow to a box "Monitoring" beside the smartphone labelled "Oculus App", with wireless-connection icons (a Wi-Fi symbol and a second radio symbol) between them; a red-lettered word "FEEDBACK" at the centre; and a curved blue arrow headed OUTPUTS running from the white-coat pictogram toward the headset pictogram with a box listing "Observation" and "Assessment". Labels "Participant" and "Therapist" sit beside the two pictograms.

clinical_significance.statement: The authors present this as a generic description of how immersive virtual reality systems work with inputs recorded by a headset and controllers and outputs from the virtual environment.

evidence.quote: VRi systems work via an input and output flow (Figure 1). Inputs are recorded by a VRi headset and controllers in response to external actions of the participant; these inputs then induce changes in the virtual environment through the software.

diagram_relations.visual_cue: Magenta arrow headed INPUTS points toward the virtual-environment screenshot, away from the headset pictogram.
Blue arrow headed OUTPUTS points toward the headset pictogram, away from the virtual-environment screenshot.
Orange arrow points down from the Virtual environment label to the Monitoring box beside the smartphone.
Curved blue arrow headed OUTPUTS points toward the headset pictogram, starting beside the white-coat pictogram.

limitations: Arrows between the therapist pictogram and the smartphone are not drawn; only the wireless-connection icons sit between the smartphone and the Virtual environment label.

visual.general_description: Three-row composite of a headset user and matching first-person virtual-environment views for the First Steps games.

panels.general_description: Three-row composite of a headset user and matching first-person virtual views of the main room, the robot dance and the space-station shooting game.
panels.detailed_description: Top row. Two side-by-side images in the top third. Left: a color photograph of a person seated on a wooden chair in a domestic room with shelving, a patterned tile floor and framed pictures; the person wears a head-mounted display and a face mask over the lower face, a dark top, red cropped trousers and grey shoes, with one arm raised holding a handheld controller and the other hand resting on a controller near the lap. Right: a first-person virtual view of a dark blue and purple room with red outlines, a framed message box in Spanish reading "Tus manos virtuales pueden hacer de todo. Vamos, juega con algunos de esos objetos." and a pale blue virtual hand holding a bright blue sphere. Middle row. Two side-by-side images in the middle third. Left: a color photograph of a person seated on a wooden chair in a domestic room with shelving and a tile floor, wearing a head-mounted display, a face mask, a dark top, red cropped trousers and grey shoes, with both hands holding controllers near the lap. Right: a first-person virtual view of a pink, purple and blue circular room with a robot character on a floor disc; text across the upper wall reads "¡Mueve las manos!", and green and colored virtual hands are near the robot. Bottom row. Two side-by-side images in the bottom third. Left: a color photograph of a person standing in a room with a patterned tile floor, dressed in dark clothing and wearing a head-mounted display, with one knee raised so that the person stands on one leg and a controller held in one hand. Right: a first-person virtual view inside a dark domed space station with blue floating cubes, a floating number "50", a thin dotted aiming line and a white gun at the lower right.

visual.general_description: Three-row composite of a headset user and matching first-person virtual views for baseball, tennis and bowling.
visual.detailed_description: Vertical composite of three rows, each with a color photograph of a person using a head-mounted display on the left and a first-person virtual-environment view on the right, on a white background. Top row: baseball field view with a glove and ball. Middle row: tennis court view with a racket and scoreboard. Bottom row: bowling lane view with a controller and red ball.

panels.general_description: Three-row composite of a headset user and matching first-person virtual views of baseball, tennis and bowling.
panels.detailed_description: Top row. Two side-by-side images in the top third. Left: a color photograph of a person standing in a room with a sofa and curtains, dressed in dark clothing and wearing a head-mounted display and a face mask, with one arm extended holding a controller; the person appears to stand on a pink cushion on the floor. Right: a first-person virtual view of a baseball field with colored stands, a large dark baseball glove holding a ball in the foreground and two scoreboards in the upper part; scoreboard text is too small to read. Middle row. Two side-by-side images in the middle third. Left: a color photograph of a person standing in a room with shelving and a figurine on a shelf, wearing a head-mounted display, a face mask, a dark long-sleeved top and red trousers, with one arm raised and bent with a clenched hand and a controller in the other hand. Right: a first-person virtual view of a blue tennis court with an orange and white racket in the foreground, palm trees, a green creature figure, banners reading "sports scramble" and "oculus quest", a scoreboard with two name labels (a player user-name label and "CPU") showing zeros, and the text "Best of 1". Bottom row. Two side-by-side images in the bottom third. Left: a color photograph, taken against bright window light, of a person in dark clothing leaning or stepping forward in a room with curtains, wearing a head-mounted display and a face mask. Right: a first-person virtual view down a wooden bowling lane with a hand controller and a red cartoon ball in the foreground, toy-like vehicles at the left and two scoreboards in the background, one labelled with a player user-name and one labelled "CPU", both showing 0.
